CommerceReturns.title: Returns
CommerceReturns.itemsCount: {count, plural, one {# sold item} other {# sold items}}
CommerceReturns.noSalesFound: No active sales matched this search.
CommerceReturns.selectItemsHelp: Enter a return quantity only for the items that came back. Previously returned quantities cannot be returned again.
CommerceReturns.independentStockHelp: This item was sold independently of TEED stock, so a return will not automatically make it available inventory. Receive it into stock separately if needed.
CommerceReturns.notSellable: Do not return to sellable stock
CommerceReturns.refundValidation: Enter a refund amount between zero and the refundable sale value.
CommerceReturns.replacementSource: Where did the replacement come from?

replacementSourceHelp.stock: Choose a TEED SKU. The replacement will reduce stock using FIFO and record its exact inventory cost.
replacementSourceHelp.independent: Use this when the replacement came from outside recorded TEED stock. Record where it came from, its identity and what it cost the business.

CommerceReturns.replacementAcquisitionPlaceholder: Supplier, shop, person or other source
CommerceReturns.replacementValidation: Complete the replacement source, identity and cost/stock details before recording the return.
CommerceReturns.emptyHistory: No returns have been recorded yet.
CommerceReturns.profitAdjustment: Return adjustment to original gross profit
CommerceReturns.profitAdjustmentHelp: This adjustment uses the actual refund paid, not an assumed full refund. FIFO continues to restore the returned item's original inventory cost independently. Replacement cost and store credit reduce the original result; recovered sellable inventory adds its original cost back.

tooltips.dateSearch: Use this when you know the day of the sale but not the receipt number.
tooltips.receiptSearch: Use this when the customer has the receipt number. TEED will look for that exact active receipt.
tooltips.receiptResult: Choose the receipt that contains the item being returned.
tooltips.quantity: Enter only the quantity coming back now. Countable units such as pieces, boxes, bottles and cars use whole numbers only. Measured units such as kilograms, grams, meters and liters can use decimals.
tooltips.condition: Sellable items return to available stock. Non-sellable items stay out of available stock and their original inventory value is reported as a damaged return.
tooltips.resolution: Choose what the customer receives because of this return. A replacement must also record where the replacement came from.
tooltips.reason: Choose one short reason so return records stay consistent and easy to analyze later.
tooltips.refundAmount: The refundable value is the selling value of the selected returned quantity. Enter the amount actually given back to the customer; deductions remain visible instead of being guessed.
tooltips.replacementSource: Stock replacements consume a TEED SKU using FIFO. Independent replacements do not touch stock and require the actual acquisition cost and source.
tooltips.replacementCost: Enter the cost per replacement unit to the business, not a selling price.
tooltips.acquisitionSource: Record where the independent replacement came from so its cost and provenance can be audited later.
tooltips.historyRelationship: Returns remain separate from Sales while preserving the exact relationship to the original receipt.

CommerceReturns.saveError: The return could not be recorded.
CommerceReturns.chooseItemError: Enter a return quantity for at least one item.
